name: Mara Vell
subtitle: Bootprints among the flowers
summary: Mara Vell tends the flower beds and paths in the village cemetery, taking quiet pride in making the place welcoming to grieving families. One morning she finds muddy bootprints crushed through the flowers she planted the night before.
tableNote: Brush soil from your gloves before answering, and glance toward the damaged flower bed whenever someone mentions the cemetery. Gentle and practical, Mara wants to protect the families who visit; she fears the prints lead to a grave that should have stayed undisturbed.
adventureHook: Mara asks the party to identify who crossed the flower bed after the cemetery gates were locked. The muddy prints end at an old, unmarked grave, where someone has recently loosened the soil and left a fresh sprig of flowers.
imageAlt: Painted fantasy portrait of Mara Vell, a worried cemetery gardener in a linen kerchief and moss-green dress, kneeling beside crushed flowers and muddy bootprints among simple grave markers.

name: Varruk “Copperhand” Drenn
subtitle: A copper for your peace of mind
summary: Varruk collects “stall insurance” from town merchants, pocketing their copper with a courteous smile and a quiet threat. His crew of three petty crooks blocks carts, harasses travelers near the gates and breaks merchandise when someone refuses to pay.
tableNote: Speak softly, straighten a copper ring before naming a price, and call every threat a friendly warning. Varruk wants a steady income without attracting the watch; he bluffs about powerful backers and loses confidence when victims stand together. His crew includes a lookout, a cutpurse and a cudgel carrier, loyal only while the money lasts.
adventureHook: A merchant hires the party to escort her cart through town without paying Varruk. When his crew blocks the lane, the youngest lookout slips the party a collection ledger: it names every victim, and Varruk intends to burn a refusing merchant’s stall after sunset.
imageAlt: Broad grey-olive half-orc with short black hair, small tusks and copper rings, wearing worn leather over a burgundy shirt and holding collected coins in a market alley.

name: Grusk Ironjaw
subtitle: Every safe passage has a price
summary: Broad-shouldered and scarred, Grusk collects illegal “street dues” from merchants at the market and travelers entering town. His ragtag crew blocks wagons, steals small valuables and threatens anyone who refuses to pay.
tableNote: Step close, crack your knuckles and speak in a low, falsely friendly voice. Grusk wants steady income and a fearsome reputation, not unnecessary bloodshed; he loses nerve if his crew deserts him or a witness mentions the town watch.
adventureHook: A caravan merchant asks the party to stop Grusk's protection racket after several wagons are robbed. Grusk insists a corrupt watch officer takes a cut of the dues—and his collection ledger may prove it.
imageAlt: Illustrated broad-shouldered olive-skinned half-orc thug with small tusks, a scarred brow, reddish scarf and battered leather armor standing in a modest town market.

name: Riggles Flintnose
subtitle: A nose for buried trouble
summary: Cautious and soft-spoken, Riggles hunts gems in the deep tunnels and trades his finds in small, carefully weighed lots. His unusually acute nose distinguishes ore dust, lamp oils and familiar belongings, making him a useful finder of lost items when a trail is fresh.
tableNote: Sniff twice before answering, keep your back near a wall, and ask who else knows about the job. Riggles wants enough trade to support his mining crew without revealing their richest seam; strong perfume and smoke can overwhelm his nose.
adventureHook: Riggles recognizes his crew’s distinctive violet ore dust on a merchant’s boots, though their latest shipment never reached the surface. He offers a share of the recovered gems if the party escorts him through the old workings beneath the market; the missing miners may still be alive.
imageAlt: Wary slate-grey deep gnome with silver hair and large pointed ears sniffing violet ore, wearing a patched brown mining coat and moss scarf in a lamplit tunnel.

name: Maera Cinderhand
subtitle: Good steel needs a steady hand
summary: Maera forges dependable weapons and repairs battered gear at a soot-darkened village forge. She promises an honest edge rather than miracles: “Fire can forge you fine weapons. Keeping them sharp is your part.”
